change: The front facade has fourteen real interior views with ambient walking visitors: bar and cabinets on floor one, six distinct views on each of floors two and three. Future facade rows stay shuttered. Only glass is transparent; native frames, pilasters, canopies, planters, entrance and sign stay above the room layer.

verification.buildScope: Host graphics only. Server, financial rules, module catalogue and independent game packages are unchanged by this task. Existing backend and module package bytes are retained with their own provenance.

streetCases.note: The existing 79 cases passed. The four new front-window cases passed separately after the final view diversity change and are now included in test:street.

scenarios: Actual room captures behind glass with proportionate noninteractive visitors
Fourteen unique front views from existing halls; no visitors in unbuilt floors
Walk and pause animation; freeze in overview, rear view, hidden page model and reduced motion
Opaque wall and original columns, window grids, sign and entrance
Window click does not enter the building or start an NPC conversation
Connected chat and unchanged balance while circling the building and returning indoors
Rear views still capture fifteen actual room sections
Existing middle-window entry, return, stairs, roof, restroom and descent to the street
